rules: A split-payment advantage only when split payment is enabled for the store (theme `features.enableYandexSplit`).
Advantage types are policy claims from the merchant; an empty slot is `{"type": "none"}`, never `{}`.

Advantage slots keep the starter template's texts until rewritten (a marketplace's pickup points, try-on, payment after try-on): `presets apply` lists every set slot in `open` and the lint warns (`advantages-unconfirmed`). Each confirmed slot gets its own `text`; the platform wording promises cash, pickup points and a courier.

presets.name: cart-divided-minimal
presets.use: Divided cards, advantages collapsed, air above.
presets.evidence: 17 stores divided; double top padding in 29
fill: `modules.advantages.advantage1..6`: Each advantage slot a type and its own `text` from facts the merchant confirmed (payment methods, delivery options, the return window): the platform wording promises cash, pickup points and a courier (`delivery`: «Доставка в пункты выдачи или до двери», `payment`: «Оплата — картой, СБП или наличными»), so keep it only where it is true. `split-payment` only with Split connected; `fitting` and `refusal` only for wearables with try-on. No confirmed policy: every slot `none` or `enableAdvantages: false`.
